questions.stem: Forearm nerve blocks at the elbow are mainly indicated for surgery on which area?
For a forearm nerve block at the elbow, how is the ultrasound probe oriented?
In forearm nerve blocks, where should local anaesthetic be placed for each nerve?
questions.answer: Next to each individual nerve (radial, median, ulnar)

questions.stem: How much local anaesthetic is given per nerve in elbow-level forearm blocks?
Why are individual forearm nerve blocks useful as a rescue technique?
questions.answer: They are targeted, keeping total local anaesthetic dose down

questions.stem: Which body territories does each blocked forearm nerve cover?
questions.answer: The hand, forearm and wrist territories of that nerve

questions.stem: In a forearm block, where is the radial nerve best seen?
options: Above the medial elbow, between biceps and triceps
Above the lateral elbow, between brachioradialis and brachialis
At the wrist, beside the anatomical snuffbox
Deep to pronator teres above the medial epicondyle

questions.stem: For the radial nerve, how far above the elbow crease is the probe placed on the arm?
What does the radial nerve look like on ultrasound in forearm blocks?
options: Anechoic tubular structure with no internal echoes
Hyperechoic triangle or oval with honeycomb pattern
Hypoechoic round structure with a dark centre
Bright linear line with no fascicles

questions.stem: At what level does the radial nerve split into superficial and deep branches?
options: At the wrist crease, beside the radial artery
High in the axilla, under pectoralis
Mid upper arm, deep to triceps

questions.stem: Proximally in the arm, where does the radial nerve lie relative to the humerus?
options: Posteriorly, deep to triceps in the spiral groove

questions.stem: For an in-plane radial nerve block, which muscle does the needle pass through?
Which motor response confirms the radial nerve during nerve stimulation?
In a radial nerve block at the elbow, after aspirating, inject ____ of local anaesthetic.
Where is the ultrasound probe placed to image the median nerve at the elbow?
questions.answer: Transverse, just above the elbow crease in the antecubital fossa

questions.stem: Which vessel do you find first when locating the median nerve at the elbow?
Proximally in the arm, what do the median nerve and brachial artery do?
In mid-forearm, which muscles lie superficial to the median nerve?
options: Pronator teres and flexor digitorum superficialis

questions.stem: For an in-plane median nerve block, which needle direction is usually easier?
Where is the ulnar nerve found at the elbow, a few centimetres above the crease?
On ultrasound, how does the ulnar nerve look at the elbow?
options: Hypoechoic round structure with no pattern
Bright thin line along the fascia

questions.stem: Distally at the elbow, the ulnar nerve dips into which groove?
How far proximally can the ulnar nerve be traced in the arm?
questions.answer: Along the medial arm to the axilla

questions.stem: Which in-plane direction is often more ergonomic for an ulnar nerve block?
